---
title: "05 - Analysis 1: Alpha diversity"
format: html
---

## Aim

Recreate Figure 1 of the study: alpha diversity of the nasopharyngeal
microbiota in SARS-CoV-2 negative samples and in each variant group, measured
with four indices (Chao1, Observed, Shannon and Simpson). The four plots are
combined into one 2 x 2 figure with patchwork.

## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")
source("99_proj_func.R")
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat_aug <- read_tsv(file = "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv") |>
  set_factor_levels()
```

The diversity indices were computed per sample in `03_augment`, so we keep one
row per sample.

```{r}
alpha_div <- dat_aug |>
  distinct(sample_id, variant, chao1, observed, shannon, simpson)

alpha_div
```

## Chao1

```{r}
plot_chao1 <- alpha_div |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = variant,
                       y = chao1,
                       fill = variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2,
              size = 0.8,
              alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colours) +
  labs(title = "A. Chao1",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Estimated richness") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_chao1
```

## Observed

```{r}
plot_observed <- alpha_div |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = variant,
                       y = observed,
                       fill = variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2,
              size = 0.8,
              alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colours) +
  labs(title = "B. Observed",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of ASVs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_observed
```

## Shannon

```{r}
plot_shannon <- alpha_div |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = variant,
                       y = shannon,
                       fill = variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2,
              size = 0.8,
              alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colours) +
  labs(title = "C. Shannon",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Shannon index (H')") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_shannon
```

## Simpson

```{r}
plot_simpson <- alpha_div |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = variant,
                       y = simpson,
                       fill = variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2,
              size = 0.8,
              alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variant_colours) +
  labs(title = "D. Simpson",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Simpson index (1 - D)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_simpson
```

## Combine the four plots

With patchwork, `|` places plots side by side and `/` stacks them, so
`(A | B) / (C | D)` gives a 2 x 2 square.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8
key_plot_alpha <- (plot_chao1 | plot_observed) /
  (plot_shannon | plot_simpson) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Alpha diversity of the nasopharyngeal microbiota",
    subtitle = "Richness (top) is similar across groups; Shannon and Simpson (bottom) are higher in SARS-CoV-2 positive samples"
  )

key_plot_alpha

ggsave(filename = "../results/05_key_plot_1.png",
       plot = key_plot_alpha,
       width = 9,
       height = 8,
       dpi = 300)
```

## Medians per group


```{r}
alpha_div |>
  group_by(variant) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            chao1 = median(chao1),
            observed = median(observed),
            shannon = median(shannon),
            simpson = median(simpson))
```
